anomalies.observed: U3 (TPS62933 buck, 24 V to +5V) pin 2 (EN) has no net. The netlist marks it as an unconnected no-connect pin ("unconnected-(U3-EN-Pad2)"), while all other buck pins (VIN, SW, BST, SS, FB, RT, GND) are wired.
anomalies.expected: A buck regulator's EN pin is normally tied to VIN or driven by a defined level, or the datasheet's floating-EN behaviour is explicitly relied on. Leaving EN floating makes the 5 V rail start-up state undefined, and the ESP32 and LDO depend on that rail.
anomalies.impact: If the TPS62933 does not have a reliable internal pull-up on EN, the +5V rail may never enable or may start erratically. That would leave the ESP32 (5V0), the LDO and the I2C/isolator supplies unpowered or unstable.
